name: wan2.6-t2i
description: wan2.6-t2i, with upgrades in image quality, aesthetic expression, and command compliance, demonstrates exceptional capabilities in precise control of artistic style, realistic and moving portraits, long-text generated images, and extensive coverage of historical and cultural IPs. It can generate high-quality and expressive visual content.
zhDescription: 万相2.6-文生图，画面质感、美学表现、指令遵循升级，在艺术风格精准控制、真实感人像、长文本生图及广泛历史文化IP覆盖上均表现出卓越能力，可生成高质量且富有表现力的视觉内容。

agentIntegrations.name: Codex
agentIntegrations.description: Configure MaaS as an OpenAI-compatible model provider.
agentIntegrations.zhDescription: 将 MaaS 配置为 Codex 的 OpenAI 兼容模型供应商。

model = "wan2.6-t2i"
model_provider = "maas"

[model_providers.maas]
name = "MaaS"
base_url = "https://maas-api.antdigital.com/v1"
env_key = "MAAS_API_KEY"
wire_api = "responses"
